tool-map.title: Two ways in, one configuration file
tool-map.alt: Diagram: you run the commands, or ru-build runs generate_matrix.py and then build_app.sh in CI; the commands load settings through config_loader.sh, build_app.sh asks get_app_info.py for the source file, the commands run idf.py, and config_loader.sh, get_app_info.py and generate_matrix.py all read app_config.yml.
tool-map.description: Top to bottom, from who starts the work to the file everything reads. There are two ways in: you run a command in a terminal, or ci-tools' ru-build runs in CI. The commands (read from the scripts that source config_loader.sh) load their settings through config_loader.sh; build_app.sh also asks get_app_info.py for an app's source file, and the build and flash commands run idf.py. In CI, ru-build first runs generate_matrix.py to get one job per app, ESP-IDF version and build type, then runs build_app.sh in each job. config_loader.sh, get_app_info.py and generate_matrix.py all read the same app_config.yml. Solid arrows run something, dashed arrows read a file.
